cause: GrammarGuide was registered in RootStack, but Practice was registered only in nested tab stacks. Its root-targeted REPLACE was unhandled.
fix: Register the existing PracticeScreen in RootStack. Replace the guide, preserve MainTabs and return to the existing grammar list on Back.
limits: Uses installed React Navigation routers and actual AppShell registrations; does not replace an iOS device test.
